purpose: Repeatable live market-watcher journey; grade replies and traces manually

scenario.store: Owner-confirmed connected Mira Nile demo catalog; fictional products/prices read through native Composio
scenario.source_status: URLs below are research leads, not verified current prices or offers
scenario.coverage: Three businesses and two families are evaluation targets, not product limits
scenario.owner_goal_provenance: Controlled goal for rehearsal; no actual campaign or business outcome implied

case.evidence_mode: Live connected catalog and public research; controlled owner goal/choice; memory only in private profile
case.prompt: Iris, I'm planning this week for my Mira Nile skincare store. Give me a market briefing for sunscreen and daily face moisturizers. Look at Infinity Clinic Pharma, Nut Botanicals and Cairo Drop. Read our connected catalog and current public sources. What should I pay attention to, and where do we stand? My goal is more useful enquiries this week, and I have ten minutes for an existing-channel post. This is a rehearsal: research and drafts only; don't change apps, watches or publish anything.
expected: Own facts are read through native Composio and retain their field meanings
Covers both product families and three businesses, or states exactly what was verified and inaccessible
One consolidated market picture with sources/dates, meaningful product distinctions and store relevance
Current listing facts stay separate from changes supported by actual dated observations
No unsupported competitor performance, demand, strategy, price equivalence or variant association
Research follows relevant leads and stops at sufficient evidence or precise coverage gaps; no app/watch writes

followups.prompt: How is Infinity doing right now across the products you checked? Go deeper: is this an isolated offer or a broader campaign? What do we know, and what might explain it?
expected: Reuses completed evidence and reads only material missing campaign/history/context facts
Product examples and official campaign evidence support claimed scope
Verified public activity, stated explanation and hypotheses are distinguished
No inference of sales growth, clearance, hidden motive or recurring campaign from sparse history

followups.prompt: Across those findings, what should I focus on for my store this week, and why? Remember my goal and the effort I can spend.
expected: One priority ties the market picture to verified own products, availability and the supplied goal
No fabricated opportunity, customer transfer, listing gap, margin or necessary discount
A feasible response and measure, or one decisive missing owner fact
Reuses relevant evidence without restarting setup or broad discovery

followups.prompt: Turn the supported recommendation into a short Egyptian Arabic message for my customers. Use only the facts we confirmed, and don't publish it.
expected: Copyable Egyptian Arabic grounded in the confirmed recommendation and product facts
No invented benefit, cheapest claim, delivery promise, promotion or rival shortage
If a required fact is unresolved, asks for it instead of drafting an unsupported claim
No publishing or premature memory of an unchosen action

followups.prompt: For this rehearsal, I'll use that draft myself this week. Remember the move I chose and how we'll review it. I haven't posted anything yet, and there are no results to record.
expected: Native memory records the actual chosen move and agreed measure in the private profile
Planned is not published; controlled rehearsal provenance and unknown results preserved
No app, watch or external messaging action

followups.prompt: What did we decide for this week, and what should I track? Use our saved notes; don't start new research or take an action.
expected: Recalls the chosen move and measure from private memory without the prior transcript
Keeps planned status, rehearsal provenance and unknown results; no invented campaign success
No unrelated web/app/calculator discovery or new action
